title: NVIDIA: How It Became the Engine of the AI Infrastructure Boom

scenes.title: COLD OPEN
scenes.subtitle: Establish the stakes with the strongest specific, source-backed fact.
scenes.narration: NVIDIA reported fiscal-year 2026 revenue of $215.9 billion, up 65%, while Data Center revenue was up 68%. NVIDIA said Gaming revenue for fiscal year 2026 was up 41%, driven by Blackwell demand. NVIDIA's gross margin decreased to 71.1% in fiscal 2026 from 75.0% in fiscal 2025; the company cited its transition to Blackwell full-scale data-center solutions and a $4.5 billion H20-related charge. NVIDIA said its supply commitments increased from $119 billion in the prior quarter to $279 billion as of July 26, 2026. NVIDIA disclosed that some supplier agreements may be canceled, rescheduled, or adjusted before firm orders, and that changes may result in additional costs. For fiscal 2026, Compute & Networking revenue was $193,479 and Graphics revenue was $22,459. For fiscal 2026, NVIDIA reported revenue by direct-customer headquarters location of $149,617 in the United States, $42,345 in Taiwan, and $19,677 in China including Hong Kong. In Q2 FY27, NVIDIA revenue was $96,221, up 106% year over year, and gross margin was 75.0%. For the third quarter of fiscal 2027, NVIDIA forecast revenue of $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, and assumed no Data Center compute revenue from China. NVIDIA reported quarterly Data Center revenue of $62.3 billion, up 75% year over year, for the fourth quarter ended January 25, 2026.

scenes.title: THE SYSTEM
scenes.subtitle: Explain the company, market, customer, and product context.
scenes.narration: NVIDIA reported fiscal-year 2026 revenue of $215.9 billion, up 65%, while Data Center revenue was up 68%. NVIDIA said Gaming revenue for fiscal year 2026 was up 41%, driven by Blackwell demand. NVIDIA describes its GPUs as the foundation of its accelerated-computing platform for parallel workloads including neural-network training and inference. NVIDIA describes its full-stack computing platform as combining chips with CUDA, CUDA-X libraries, AI models and training datasets, APIs, SDKs, and application frameworks. NVIDIA's gross margin decreased to 71.1% in fiscal 2026 from 75.0% in fiscal 2025; the company cited its transition to Blackwell full-scale data-center solutions and a $4.5 billion H20-related charge. NVIDIA said its supply commitments increased from $119 billion in the prior quarter to $279 billion as of July 26, 2026. NVIDIA disclosed that some supplier agreements may be canceled, rescheduled, or adjusted before firm orders, and that changes may result in additional costs. The CUDA Programming Guide describes CUDA as a parallel-computing platform and programming model developed by NVIDIA that uses GPU processing power. For fiscal 2026, Compute & Networking revenue was $193,479 and Graphics revenue was $22,459. For fiscal 2026, Compute & Networking segment operating income was $130,141 and Graphics segment operating income was $9,156. For fiscal 2026, NVIDIA reported revenue by direct-customer headquarters location of $149,617 in the United States, $42,345 in Taiwan, and $19,677 in China including Hong Kong. In Q2 FY27, NVIDIA revenue was $96,221, up 106% year over year, and gross margin was 75.0%.
